file_identity.name: TH3 B0DY SOURCES
file_identity.purpose: Complete citation record for every [Documented] and [Credible allegation] claim in TH3 B0DY. Each entry includes: full title, author(s), publisher, year, URL (where available), and a one-line note on what the source confirms. [Theoretical] claims are listed with no source — they are structural inferences from documented patterns, not evidence-backed claims. If a URL has changed or died, use the title, author, publisher, and year to locate the source independently. Report updated URLs to the canonical repository.
file_identity.url_policy: URLs are provided as access points, not as the primary identifier. The primary identifier is always: title + author + publisher + year. URLs rot. Titles do not.

evidence_levels.Documented: Court records, official investigations, financial disclosures, parliamentary reports, declassified government documents, peer-reviewed research, journalism with named sources and documentary evidence.
evidence_levels.Credible_allegation: Reported by serious journalists or researchers, not proven in court or through official process, but credible evidence exists.
evidence_levels.Contested: Debated among historians or researchers. Evidence on both sides.
evidence_levels.Theoretical: Logical inference from known structures. No direct evidence. No source citation — listed for transparency.
